# callisto configuration

[[fixed-group]]
name = "workspace"
members = [
    "cargo/callisto-model",
    "cargo/callisto-manifests",
    "cargo/callisto-graph",
    "cargo/callisto-cli",
    "cargo/callisto-fixtures",
]

[changesets]
dir = ".changeset"

[release]
product-package = "cargo/callisto-cli"
forge-repository = "orin-dx/callisto"

[[release.artifact]]
package = "cargo/callisto-cli"
target = "aarch64-apple-darwin"
asset-name = "callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"

[[release.artifact]]
package = "cargo/callisto-cli"
target = "x86_64-apple-darwin"
asset-name = "callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"

[[release.artifact]]
Changesets-style version and release manager for Cargo, npm and Python workspaces

Usage: callisto [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add          Create a new changeset describing pending package changes
  status       Show the workspace's pending changesets and diagnostics
  version      Consume pending changesets and bump package versions accordingly
  pre          Manage prerelease mode for the workspace
  snapshot     Apply a temporary, non-persistent version bump for a snapshot release
  init         Scaffold Callisto configuration in the current workspace
  release      Publish every package whose current version has not been released yet
  completions  Generate shell completion scripts

Options:
      --format <FORMAT>  Output format for command results [default: text] [possible values: text, json]
      --cwd <CWD>        Workspace directory to operate in (defaults to the current directory) [default: .]
      --dry-run          Preview manifest and file changes without writing to disk
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version

docs/adr/0001-changesets-compatible-change-records.md:18:- **A callisto-specific format** — rejected: adoption and rollback must each be one commit, so existing `.changeset/` files have to keep working in both directions ("One-commit adoption, one-commit rollback. This is the adoption gate; nothing overrides it", docs/00-design.md §4 P1).
docs/specs/workspace.json:179:      "criterion": "A matched rule overrides only the fields it sets; otherwise a package uses release trigger `changeset`, `CHANGELOG.md` in its directory (a configured changelog is relative to the package directory), and the publish targets its manifests declare."
docs/specs/release.json:254:      "criterion": "A `pypi` `[registries]` entry may set `publish-url`, the endpoint Twine uploads to when the index at `url` is not also the upload route. Both endpoints follow the registry URL rules of REL-PUB-05 and both enter the registry binding, so changing either makes an earlier intent stale. A package-level `publish-to` index names both routes and overrides the entry's `publish-url`. A `publish-url` on a registry that is not `pypi` is rejected when the configuration loads."
docs/specs/release.json:390:      "criterion": "With `source: auto`, `callisto-action` and `setup-callisto` default `version` input `latest` installs the callisto release the action's own invocation is pinned to (`github.action_ref` resolved against `orin-dx/callisto`'s `callisto@` tags), falling back to the newest published release only when that ref is unset or matches no tag. A failed tag lookup fails the step. An explicit `version` input overrides this resolution, including inside a Callisto checkout. A consumer manifest mentioning callisto-cli never selects a local build. `source: local` ignores version pins and requires Git-tracked Callisto source at the checkout root plus Cargo metadata confirming the local callisto-cli workspace member, manifest path and callisto binary target. Local builds use explicit manifest and output-directory paths; invalid local source fails without falling back to a downloaded or registry installation."
docs/config.md:16:| `[registries]` | table of tables | no | Registry endpoint overrides |
docs/config.md:17:| `[[package]]` | array of tables | no | Per-package exact-match overrides |
docs/config.md:18:| `[[package-set]]` | array of tables | no | Per-package glob-match overrides |
README.md:98:- Tags are `{name}@{version}`, or `ecosystem/name@{version}` when another ecosystem has a package of that name; `tag-template` overrides them ([stability](docs/stability.md)). Release notes come from the package's changelog section.

input.message:
**Verdict: partial gap. Top-level `overrides` and `resolutions` are rewritten, but only in a manifest that also declares the dependency. `pnpm.overrides` is never touched, and root-level pins are left stale.**

**Code.** `update_dependency_spec` in `crates/callisto-manifests/src/npm.rs` (~l.500-520) loops over `["overrides","resolutions"]` and rewrites the entry only if `name` is also in the primary dependency section. A guard also skips values with `$` or `:`. `iter_dependencies` reads only the four dependency sections. Nothing references `pnpm.overrides` or nested override objects. Tests in `npm/tests.rs` ~l.640-730 cover the co-mutation case only.

**Proof.** I built the CLI into `/tmp/claude-501/tgt` and ran it on a throwaway git workspace. `@acme/lib` 1.0.0 got a `major` changeset, giving 2.0.0.

Input in `@acme/app` (1.0.0):
```
"dependencies": {"@acme/lib":"^1.0.0"},
"overrides": {"@acme/lib":"1.0.0"},
"pnpm": {"overrides": {"@acme/lib":"1.0.0"}}
```
Output in `@acme/app` (now 1.0.1):
```
"dependencies": {"@acme/lib":"^2.0.0"},
"overrides": {"@acme/lib":"^2.0.0"},
"pnpm": {"overrides": {"@acme/lib":"1.0.0"}}
```
The root `package.json` was unchanged. It had `overrides`, `resolutions` and `pnpm.overrides` all at `1.0.0`, and the root declares no dependency on the package.

**Impact.** The stale pin still forces `@acme/lib@1.0.0` at install time, which silently contradicts the bump. No error is raised.

**Likelihood.** Low to moderate. Root-level overrides are the usual place for pnpm and yarn pins, so a monorepo that pins its own workspace packages would hit it.

**Smallest fix.** In the same loop, also rewrite `pnpm.overrides`. Rewriting root-level pins needs a separate root-manifest pass, which is larger. Otherwise, document it.
